title: Hollow Body Hold
summary: A gymnastics core hold: lower back pressed into the floor, arms and legs raised. It's good for core control, with a modest muscle stimulus.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.6 for abs (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.2 for quads: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly quads total.

setup.text: Lie on your back, press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few inches.

form_cues.cue: Press the lower back into the floor
If your back lifts, bend your knees.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
